listing.title: PREEDAYA Handmade Pink Crochet Floral Pearl Drop Earrings
listing.description: Handcrafted floral earrings made with pink crochet thread, small gold-tone bead accents and a pearl-style drop. The lightweight statement pair is designed to complement sarees, kurtis, dresses and Indo-western outfits for festive events, weddings, parties or casual wear. Handmade construction can produce small variations between pairs.
listing.returnConditions: Returns or exchanges are accepted within 10 days of delivery under the standard Hastabazaar return policy.
